name: coding-agent
description: Takes a Technical Design Document (PDF) from planning_agent and, for every service it names, downloads the code at the TDD's commit, makes the change and opens a pull request (a draft unless every check passed) on a new branch. Jenkins builds the branch.

triggers.name: uploaded_files
triggers.description: The Technical Design Document to implement, as the PDF planning_agent made.

triggers.name: branch_name
triggers.description: Name of the NEW branch to push in every repo the TDD changes, e.g. sm/KS-17392-2. It must not exist yet. Leave empty for a generated fix/... name.
